product_metadata.title: QUEEN ROSE Queen Mattress Topper, Cooling Extra Thick 3D Snow Soft Pillow Topper Mattress Pad Cover Bed Mattress Topper, Hotel Quality, Down Alternative, Plush and Support
features: Drive Out Body Heat - This premium topper has layer which balance temperature control ensures you stay cool in summer and warm in winter to enjoy optimal relaxing, reading and sleeping.

Care Your Sound Sleep - Sleeping takes up 1/3 in our life, so stop fighting with bad sleep with uncomfortable mattress. This plush cozy topper offer optimal support to help back pain relief, say good bye to insomnia.

Refresh Your Old Mattress - To extend mattress life, most pillow top mattress topper is not thick enough that’s why we add more filling than other pads on the market, this extra cushion to bring you extraordinary level of comfort and support for your shoulders and hips, jump into cloud-like mattress topper and fall asleep one second.

Stable Anchor Bands - Its classic, high end baffle box to avoid filling from moving or feathers leaking out, besides with extra firm 4 anchor bands stretch your full topper keeps it secure so you're able to relax on a cloud of comfort.

Packed in vacuum sealed package, the topper looks flat when you received it. Please air it out for 72 hours to reach its fullest potential. Recommend fluff up by: 1. Pat or shake it by hand from different directions, don’t forget the middle baffle box. 2. Tumble dry on low heat for 15 minutes. Feel free to contact us for any assistance, we are at your service.
